written.headline: Pentagon officials discussed using Defense Production Act over Nvidia CEO role
written.summary: Pete Hegseth and other Pentagon officials discussed using the Cold War-era Defense Production Act as leverage to pressure Nvidia's board. The law gives U.S. presidents extraordinary power to intervene in the economy.

written.headline: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance risks
written.summary: S&P Global Ratings is considering a one-notch credit downgrade for Nvidia from AA to AA- following concerns over management practices and heavy reliance on CEO Jensen Huang. The review was triggered by the ouster and subsequent reinstatement of Huang.

written.headline: US chip curbs stall billions in data center loans tied to Chinese firms
written.summary: New US chip export restrictions have halted billions of dollars in data center loans tied to Chinese firms including ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent. Lenders are delaying deals such as Bain Capital's Bridge Data Centres $6.6 billion loan and reassessing financing for projects in Malaysia and Singapore.

written.headline: New York governor signs five-year ban on AI chatbot toys
written.summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a bill banning the manufacture, exchange, distribution, and sale of AI chatbot toys for five years. The law takes effect in February, making New York the second US state to enact a ban following California.

written.headline: ElevenLabs in early talks for 2027 funding round at $33B target valuation
written.summary: ElevenLabs is in early discussions for a funding round planned for the first quarter of 2027 at a $33 billion target valuation, up from $22 billion in September. The voice AI company's annual recurring revenue has reached $700 million.
